items.question: Under what condition can one whose mind is fixed on that remain uncut even when being cut?
premises: Cutting is taking place at the level of the body or form.
A mind fixed on that is directed elsewhere than the object being cut.
That fixation alters the locus to which the act of cutting applies.
items.inference: When the mind is gone to that and fixed on it, the act of cutting does not reach the one so absorbed.
uncertainties: The precise scope of 'that' remains determined by context rather than this verse alone.
items.plain_english: Even if one is being cut, one whose mind is fixed on that is not cut, just so.
